# Covison

> Covison is an AI automation and digital solutions company for B2B
> businesses: AI systems, custom software, cloud/data infrastructure, and
> logistics dispatching, delivered by a senior team without agency overhead.

Covison also builds and runs its own products, including Covison CRM, a
free customer relationship management platform.

## Products

- [Covison CRM](https://crm.covison.com): A free CRM for managing leads,
  contacts, deals, and follow-ups from one workspace. Free to use, with no
  trial period and no credit card required to get started.

  touch.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Covison CRM (crm.covison.com) is free: no trial period, no credit card
  required.
- Covison the company is a paid B2B services provider (AI automation,
  software, cloud/data, logistics); Covison CRM is a separate, free product
  Covison builds and runs.
